title: Countries
about: Pin the country before you date the photo: script, driving side, currency on price tags and web addresses on shop signs narrow it fast. Many of these also date the photo: old currencies (francs, marks, lira, pesetas) mean before 2002 in the euro area, and some countries switched driving side.
